content.text: Please add another PR with this ticket for removing "mimeType" from the "repository" ontology:
I've removed mimeType from the repository ontology.
to also use the updated properties when setting the mime type and/or filename when uploading new files.
Please move the status with "Start Review" when this is ready.
, the following fcrepo4-release-tests test needs to be updated:
Looks good. Pending fix to fcrepo4-release-tests.
, I'm seeing 4 failures when I run fcrepo4-release-tests against fcrepo-1532.  Though I notice that fcrepo-1532's version is still 4.1.2-SNAPSHOT instead of 4.2.1-SNAPSHOT – do I need to rebase it?
and also updated fcrepo4-release-tests for the new mime type predicate:

Filename and mimeType are currently server-managed, so they cannot be updated once they are set.  Other server-managed properties (creation/modification dates, file size and sha1 checksum) are closely tied to the underlying storage, and modifying them could be problematic.  But filename and mimeType can safely be modified, so we should allow that.

comments.body:
PR-791 looks good.
Please add another PR with this ticket for removing "mimeType" from the "repository" ontology:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/blob/master/repository.rdf#L211-L216

Andrew-

I've removed mimeType from the repository ontology.
I've updated https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/791 to also use the updated properties when setting the mime type and/or filename when uploading new files.
Please move the status with "Start Review" when this is ready.

Former user, the following fcrepo4-release-tests test needs to be updated:
SparqlRecipesIT.testSparqlQueries1:239 expected:<http://localhost:46064/fcrepo-webapp/rest/objects/103, http://localhost:46064/fcrepo-webapp/rest/objects/101> but was:<[]>

Andrew Woods, I'm seeing 4 failures when I run fcrepo4-release-tests against fcrepo-1532. Though I notice that fcrepo-1532's version is still 4.1.2-SNAPSHOT instead of 4.2.1-SNAPSHOT – do I need to rebase it?

I've replaced #791 with https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/843 and also updated fcrepo4-release-tests for the new mime type predicate: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-release-tests/pull/13

Resolved with: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/aadf58de7a4a8d11372c220987bd5da4169a3fea
and merge of PR-13

Documentation also updated:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=67242871&selectedPageVersions=6&selectedPageVersions=7
